metadata.description: Minga — a lean, security-first team of agents and skills for Claude Code. Install the core, then only the stack packs you use.

plugins.name: minga
plugins.description: Core: 12 agents and 17 skills to plan, build, verify and publish safely, plus a hook that blocks leaking secrets and asks before destructive commands.

plugins.name: minga-python
plugins.description: Python stack pack: project tooling, idioms, typing, pytest, security pitfalls, build-error playbook and review checklist; Django, FastAPI, Flask notes.

plugins.name: minga-typescript
plugins.description: JavaScript/TypeScript stack pack: Node, React, Next.js, Vue, Angular, Svelte — tooling, types, testing, security, bundle and build errors.

plugins.name: minga-go
plugins.description: Go stack pack: modules, idioms, errors, concurrency, testing, security and review checklist.

plugins.name: minga-rust
plugins.description: Rust stack pack: cargo, ownership and lifetimes, error handling, async, testing, unsafe review, clippy.

plugins.name: minga-jvm
plugins.description: Java/Kotlin stack pack: Gradle/Maven, Spring Boot, Kotlin coroutines, Android, JUnit, security and build errors.

plugins.name: minga-dotnet
plugins.description: C#/.NET stack pack: SDK projects, ASP.NET Core, EF Core, async, xUnit/NUnit, security and build errors.

plugins.name: minga-php
plugins.description: PHP stack pack: Composer, Laravel, Symfony, PHPUnit/Pest, static analysis, security pitfalls.

plugins.name: minga-ruby
plugins.description: Ruby stack pack: Bundler, Rails, RSpec/Minitest, RuboCop, security pitfalls and performance.

plugins.name: minga-swift
plugins.description: Swift stack pack: SwiftPM/Xcode, SwiftUI, concurrency, XCTest/Swift Testing, iOS app review.

plugins.name: minga-flutter
plugins.description: Dart/Flutter stack pack: project layout, state management, widget testing, platform builds, performance.

plugins.name: minga-cpp
plugins.description: C/C++ stack pack: CMake, modern C++, memory safety, sanitizers, testing, build and linker errors.

plugins.name: minga-data
plugins.description: Data pack: SQL and schema design, PostgreSQL/MySQL/SQLite, migrations, ORMs, indexes and query tuning, Redis.

plugins.name: minga-devops
plugins.description: DevOps pack: Docker, Compose, Kubernetes, Terraform, GitHub Actions and CI hardening, deploy and observability.

plugins.name: minga-web
plugins.description: Web pack: agents and skills for websites, landing pages, SEO and accessibility audits, and chat bots.

plugins.name: minga-content
plugins.description: Content and business pack: video scripts, articles, content plans and unit economics.

plugins.name: minga-graph
plugins.description: Code knowledge graph: query, explain, path and impact over a local, explainable graph of your codebase (minga-graph CLI). No network, no telemetry.
